section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: The function \(W\) gives the temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit, of a pot of water on a stove \(t\) minutes after the stove is turned on. After 30 minutes, the pot is taken off the stove.
The graph of the function is shown.

image.alt: graph of temperature of water over time

div.para: No, 250 is not in the range. The highest temperature is 212 degrees Fahrenheit.

list.item: Is 250 in the range of function \(W\)? Explain how you know.

div.para: The range is all values between 75 and 212, the lowest and the highest temperature; \(75\leq y\leq212.\)
